dedupe_keys.name: climate central coastal risk finder and surging seas sea level rise maps

description: Climate Central's Coastal Risk Finder, successor to the Surging Seas maps, is an interactive tool of sea level rise and coastal flood risk maps that shows local flood projections, who and what is at risk, and possible solutions, with a global risk zone map exploring inundation up to 30 metres and local sea level projections at more than 1,000 tide gauges. The maps are built on CoastalDEM, Climate Central's proprietary bare-earth elevation model for low-lying coasts, now in version 3.0. Climate Central is an independent non-profit; the maps are free to use online and can be exported as images, while CoastalDEM data are licensed commercially, with sample data and a no-cost version for students and researchers on application. Caveats: projections are static inundation screening, not hydrodynamic flood models, local defences are only partly represented, and full elevation data are paid. It supports coastal hazard exposure screening of infrastructure under sea level rise scenarios; a related record is the DIVA coastal model.
licence: Free online maps (Climate Central terms); CoastalDEM proprietary

notes: The 30 m and 1,000 tide gauge figures are from Climate Central's own search listing of the global risk zone map.
